name: mono
title: MONO 3 synth engine (classic 3-oscillator mono synth, polyphonic)
summary: Pick MONO 3 in the engine list or the 'mono 3' preset: a classic three-oscillator mono synth voice, 4 voices: three oscillators with range (LO..2'), wave (triangle, shark / ramp, saw, square, two pulses) and level each, osc 2 / 3 tuned against osc 1, white / pink noise; a 4-pole ladder (cutoff, emphasis to self-oscillation, bass loss, keyboard control 1/3 / 2/3 / full), its contour (attack, decay, sustain, amount) and the loudness contour with a decay switch, constant-time glide. Page 1 (cutoff, emphasis, contour) can be moved by TE's LFO. Shift + blue turn browses P-- and 16 built-in sounds; page 7 = the sound's FX knobs. The screen draws a synth panel (the page's knobs lit), the sound's name over it for 1 s when picked, and the page's knobs as STATION 1 (name and bar). Presets stay drwave presets with in-range values.
controls: engine list: MONO 3; preset browser: folder mono 3 (one preset, 'mono 3'); sounds: shift + blue turn (P-- + 16)

MONO 3 sound: knob push cycles page 1 FILTER (CUTOFF EMPHASIS CONTOUR GLIDE) / 2 OSC 1 (RANGE WAVE VOLUME NOISE) / 3 OSC 2 (RANGE FREQUENCY WAVE VOLUME) / 4 OSC 3 (the same) / 5 FILTER CONTOUR (ATTACK DECAY SUSTAIN KEYBOARD) / 6 LOUDNESS CONTOUR (ATTACK DECAY SUSTAIN RELEASE) / 7 FX knobs

sql: INSERT INTO synth_types (id, type, default_params) SELECT MAX(id) + 1, 'mono 3', '[4114,2573,9616,608,9239,12229,8621,9874]' FROM synth_types
